title: 리얼미터
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop and J-Rock fusion with elements of Funk Rock. The arrangement features a bright, overdriven electric guitar playing syncopated rhythmic stabs and melodic lead fills. A slap bass guitar follows the kick drum closely with percussive pops. The drum kit uses a crisp snare and active hi-hat patterns with frequent open-hat accents. Male lead vocals are delivered in a rhythmic, almost spoken-word style in the verses, transitioning to a melodic, belted delivery in the chorus. A subtle synthesizer pad provides harmonic backing in the mid-range. The tempo is 124 BPM in the key of E Major.
